patthana17.10:1.1: kusalaṃ sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. dve mūlāni, cha.
patthana17.10:2.1: abyākataṃ asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.10:3.1: abyākataṃ nevasekhānāsekhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na abyākato na nevasekhānāsekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca.
